auth.token_source: Team Settings > Single Sign-On (SSO) > SCIM Authentication Token
auth.notes: Okta's API Token field and Entra's Secret Token both take the SCIM Authentication Token; Bearer scheme inferred from those IdP fields.

deprovision.notes: Docs list both 'Deactivating users' and 'Deprovisioning users' without saying what happens to the account or its pads. Plans have unlimited users, so seats do not apply.

roles.how: SCIM groups are configured in CoderPad to set permissions (admin/member) and teams; ungrouped users get the Member role.

limitations.text: SCIM can only be turned on after SSO is activated (Enterprise only).
Attribute mappings with value filters such as [type eq ...] break provisioning and must be removed.
Group names cannot be edited in CoderPad; they come from the IdP.
SCIM-created users must still verify their email and log in once at app.coderpad.io before they can use the IdP tile.
No JIT provisioning or Single Logout.

scim.notes: SCIM URL and token are shown in CoderPad's SSO settings after SSO is saved; the URL pattern and SCIM version are not published.

capabilities.notes: Only a read endpoint for organization users (optionally filtered by email) is documented; no write endpoints for users exist in the collection.

rate_limits.text: HTTP 429 'Over quota' when the plan's monthly pad allowance is exceeded; no request-rate limit published.

limitations.text: The Interview API is pad- and question-centric; user lifecycle changes need SCIM or the web UI.

okta.notes: Okta lists SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push. Builder not stated.

entra.notes: No gallery app; CoderPad documents a non-gallery enterprise app for SAML and SCIM.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Workspace; no provisioning documented.

row.evidence: CoderPad's SSO docs say "Only Enterprise plans support SSO integration" and that SSO "can also be combined with User Provisioning through the SCIM protocol"; the pricing page lists SSO / SAML and API access only in the Custom-priced Enterprise column.
row.notes: Flat per-organization pricing with unlimited users, metered by interviews/tests: Starter $80/mo annual ($120 monthly, 60 interviews/yr), Team $400/mo annual ($500 monthly, 360 interviews/yr), Enterprise custom. Unchanged since June. SCIM (Okta catalogue app; Entra via a non-gallery app) is set up after SSO, so it needs Enterprise. The public Interview API (Enterprise, API key) is mostly about pads and questions; for users it only lists organization users (read only).
